categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Matches the Wallet label and modifies sendall RPC option validation in the wallet.
categories.rationale: Silently ignoring misspelled options in sendall can lead to unintended spends of all UTXOs or accidental transaction broadcasts. As the PR notes, a typo like 'input' instead of 'inputs' causes the wallet to spend all available UTXOs instead of the intended subset, and misspelled 'add_to_wallet' or 'psbt' can trigger an unwanted broadcast. Bringing sendall into alignment with other wallet RPCs that reject unknown options directly prevents costly user errors.
